shortDescription: Brazil's ex-President Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to an intensive care unit at the DF Star hospital in the capital Brasilia, the hospital said in a statement on Saturday.

children: Brazil's ex-President Jair Bolsonaro was admitted to an intensive care unit at the DF Star hospital in the capital Brasilia, the hospital said in a statement on Saturday.
Bolsonaro has been serving a 27-year prison sentence since last year for plotting a coup after losing the 2022 election to current President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
He was diagnosed with an acute obstruction in his abdomen on Friday
Clinicians have initiated treatment to keep Bolsonaro hydrated and he has been fitted with a gastric tube
The former president is clinically stable and conscious but there is no forecasted discharge at this time
Bolsonaro, who governed from 2019 to 2022, has a history of hospitalizations and surgeries related to a stabbing in the abdomen during a 2018 campaign event
